## Part 1: Data Processing

### Parsing Variable Values

```{r}
# Function to Parse Variable Values
variable_get <- function( YEAR) {
  
  # 1) Create jsonURL based on year selected
  jsonURL <- str_c("https://api.census.gov/data/", YEAR, 
                   "/acs/acs1/pums/variables.json")

  # 2) Use get() to call unparsed data
  unparsed_data <- httr::GET(jsonURL)
  str(unparsed_data, max.level = 1)
  
  # 3) parse returned information for the actual article information
  raw_json <- content(unparsed_data, as = "text")
  raw_data <- fromJSON(raw_json)
  parsed_data <- raw_data$variables
  
  # 4) Filter only necessary variables
    # 4.1) If  condition to alter needed variables based on year
    if (YEAR %in% c("2021", "2022")) {
    varlist <- c("AGEP", "GASP", "GRPIP", "JWAP", "JWDP", "JWMNP", 
                 "PWGTP", "FER", "HHL", "SCH", "SCHL", "SEX", 
                 "REGION", "DIVISION", "ST")
    }
    else if (YEAR %in% c("2023", "2024")) {
    varlist <- c("AGEP", "GASP", "GRPIP", "JWAP", "JWDP", "JWMNP",
                 "PWGTP", "FER", "HHL", "SCH", "SCHL", "SEX", 
                 "REGION", "DIVISION", "STATE")
        
    }
    
    # 4.2) create a list of variables that are both requested and present
    targets <- intersect(varlist, names(parsed_data))
    
    # 4.3) select matching vars from data. 
    output <- parsed_data[targets]
  
  
  # 5) save .RDS file to Datafolder
      # 5.1) Create unique file name per year to save to data folder
        outfile <- str_c("Data/", YEAR, ".rds")
        
      # 5.2) Save output as RDS
        saveRDS(output, file = outfile)
        
  #this is just for QC, print dataframe for review
  return(output)
}


#Call 2021 Data
variable_get("2021")

#Call 2022 Data
variable_get("2022")

#Call 2023 Data
variable_get("2023")

#Call 2024 Data
variable_get("2024")
```

#HELPER FUNCTION 1: to parse and convert to tibble
parse_data <- function(YEAR, KEY){
#create URL
  URL <- str_c("https://api.census.gov/data/", 
             YEAR, "/acs/acs1/pums?get=SEX,PWGTP,MAR&for=state:*&SCHL=24&key=", KEY)

# Get and string data 
unparsed_data <- httr::GET(URL)
str(unparsed_data, max.level = 1)  
   
#Content and prase the data
raw_json <- content(unparsed_data, as = "text")
raw_data <- fromJSON(raw_json)

# Store as tibble Handle data to clean and format columns
output <- as_tibble(raw_data[-1, ], .name_repair = "minimal") %>%
            set_names(toupper(raw_data[1, ])) 

#Return the results for outputing
return(output)
}

#HELPER FUNCTION 2: DATE TIME (Helped from LLMs as per guidelines)
# Helper 1: Parses time interval strings and returns the midpoint time
parse_pums_time_midpoint <- function(time_str) {
  if (is.na(time_str) || time_str == "" || time_str == "N/A") return(hms(NA))
  
  # Example pattern: "08:00 a.m. to 08:04 a.m."
  # Extract all HH:MM matches and AM/PM indicators
  times <- str_extract_all(time_str, "\\d{2}:\\d{2}\\s*(a\\.m\\.|p\\.m\\.|am|pm)")[[1]]
  
  if (length(times) < 2) return(hms(NA)) # Return NA if it doesn't match an interval
  
  # Convert extracted strings to full datetime objects to calculate midpoint cleanly
  t1 <- hm(str_extract(times[1], "\\d{2}:\\d{2}"))
  t2 <- hm(str_extract(times[2], "\\d{2}:\\d{2}"))
  
  # Adjust for PM
  if (str_detect(tolower(times[1]), "p\\.m\\.|pm") && hour(t1) < 12) t1 <- t1 + hours(12)
  if (str_detect(tolower(times[2]), "p\\.m\\.|pm") && hour(t2) < 12) t2 <- t2 + hours(12)
  # Handle midnight transitions if necessary (e.g., 11:50 pm to 12:05 am)
  if (t2 < t1) t2 <- t2 + hours(24)
  
  # Calculate midpoint seconds from midnight
  s1 <- as.numeric(t1)
  s2 <- as.numeric(t2)
  midpoint_seconds <- (s1 + s2) / 2
  
  # Wrap back into an hms time object (modulus handles rolling over 24 hours)
  return(seconds_to_period(midpoint_seconds %% 86400))
}


# Create Function to take year and key to parse data, convert to tibble, 
# and handle the various options requested in the project outline
parse_pums <- function(YEAR = 2024,
                       NUM_VARS = c("AGEP", "PWGTP"),
                       CAT_VARS = c("SEX"),
                       GEO_LEVELS = "State",
                       GEO_SUBSET = NULL,){
  
parsed_data <- parse_data(YEAR, KEY) 

for (var in numeric_vars) {
    if (var %in% c("JWAP", "JWDP")) {
    # Apply Midpoint Time Helper
      df[[var]] <- map(df[[var]], parse_pums_time_midpoint) 
    } else {
      df[[var]] <- as.numeric(df[[var]])
    }
}

sex_levels <- c("1" = "Male", "2" = "Female")
schl_levels <- c("24" = "Doctorate degree", "23" = "Professional degree", "22" = "Master's degree") 

for (var in categorical_vars) {
  if (var == "SEX") {
    df[[var]] <- factor(df[[var]], levels = names(sex_levels), labels = sex_levels)
  } else if (var == "SCHL") {
    df[[var]] <- factor(df[[var]], levels = names(schl_levels), labels = schl_levels)
  } else {
    df[[var]] <- as.factor(df[[var]])
  }
}

class(df) <- c("census", class(df))
return(df)
}
